// @tether
// @symbol Entries
export type Entries = import("node:fs").Dirent[]

// @tether
// @symbol Blocks
export type Blocks = readonly import("../core/schemas").ContentBlock[]

// @tether
// @symbol Effect
export type Effect = import("effect").Effect.Effect<string, never>

// @tether
// @symbol Binding
export type Binding = import("../api").ImportClause["namedBindings"]

// @tether
// @symbol Hook
export type Hook = () => import("effect").Effect.Effect<string, unknown, never>

// @tether
// @symbol entries
export let entries: import("node:fs").Dirent[]

// @tether
// @symbol Obj
export type Obj = { readonly contentBlocks?: readonly import("../core/schemas").ContentBlock[] }
